verdict.rationale: The evidence covers adjacent IP work: securing IP ownership at formation, licensing and strategic transactions, open source compliance, and trade secret matters within employment. Nothing documents trademark clearance, registration, or brand enforcement, or a dedicated trademark practice or team. For a law firm this is an applicable axis, so the absence of evidence yields none.
